( I would have made the requirement just a [/color][color=#dd7e6b]Carp[/color][color=#ffffff], and not just any [/color][color=#dd7e6b]fishes[/color][color=#ffffff], [/color] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#ffffff]but, I don't know how to code that.)[/color]

[/color] ﻿
[color=#ffffff]Procedure:[/color]
﻿ [color=#ffffff]﻿- If you have any [/color][color=#dd7e6b]fish[/color][color=#f4f4f4] in you[/color][color=#f4f4f4]﻿r inventory, make sure your character is holding the [/color]﻿[color=#999999]20 pieces of Void Egg[/color][color=#f4f4f4], then press on the machine[/color]

The [/color][color=#00ffff]transformation[/color][color=#f4f4f4] will take many days, so be patient.
